why.title: Why do we ask this?
why.disclaimer: This is general information to help you prepare, not legal advice.
why.dateOfBirth: Your date of birth ties your application to your passport and identity documents, and some requirements or fee categories can differ by age.
why.nationality: Nationality can shape which documents a consulate asks for and how your application is handled. It's part of your core identity details.
why.countryOfResidence: Where you currently live often decides which consulate or visa centre handles your application — which can differ from your nationality.
why.passportExpiry: Consulates generally prefer a passport that stays valid for a while beyond your travel dates, so it's worth checking the expiry date early.
why.passportType: Ordinary passports cover most travel. Diplomatic, service and other types can follow different rules, so it helps to record which one you hold.
why.previousVisas: A record of past visas helps you answer application questions consistently and keep your own travel-document history in one place.
why.travelHistory: A short history of previous trips helps you answer travel-history questions accurately and keep your records together.
